title: Kissed Norwegian Suet Hash
description: A shaggy, sour Norwegian dish featuring suet, perfect for a hangover cure, now adapted to be pescatarian-friendly using fish broth and omitting the traditional lamb's kidney. Air frying gives a crispy exterior and a tender interior.

ingredients.name: suet
ingredients.notes: beef suet or other animal fat

instructions: Cut the suet into small pieces and grind them in a food processor to create a coarse crumb.
In a large bowl, mix the suet crumb with the chopped onions, flour, fish broth, beef broth (if using), sour cream (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Mix well until the ingredients are evenly combined.
Add the baking powder to the mixture and stir to incorporate.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into a rough square or rectangle, about 2 cm (3/4 inch) thick.
Place the mixture in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Cook for 12 minutes or until the suet is golden brown and crispy on the outside.
Remove the suet hash from the air fryer and let it cool slightly.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
Serve hot, with your choice of accompaniments such as boiled potatoes, pickled red cabbage, or rye bread.
